authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2563 oṣṭha explicitly gives Nepali oṭh, Kumauni ōṭh and Maithili/Bhojpuri oṭh lip. The selected nonnasal, non-h-initial oṭh/oṭʰ lips responses fit that plain lip stem, with the survey plural gloss and aspiration notation preserved. No lower-lip compound is inferred; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: oṭʰ.
